LUMIEVE Affiliate Program – Terms & Conditions


Welcome to LUMIEVE! By registering for and participating in the LUMIEVE Affiliate Program (“Program”), you (“Affiliate”) agree to the following Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, do not register or participate.



1) Application & Approval



We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.



2) Tracking Links & Coupon Codes



Affiliates will receive a unique tracking link. If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent eligible click may receive credit, based on our tracking settings.

Affiliates may be assigned a coupon code. If a customer uses a coupon and an affiliate link, commissions are not doubled. If you are not assigned a coupon code, you may not promote LUMIEVE discount codes.



3) Commission & Eligibility



Commissions are calculated on the order subtotal (excluding taxes, shipping, shipping taxes, tips, and other fees).

Commissions are only payable for successfully completed transactions. Orders that are refunded, canceled, disputed, or charged back are not eligible for payout.



4) Payout Schedule & Methods



Payouts are processed monthly (Net 30), after the return/refund review window.

Affiliates must provide valid payout details in their affiliate dashboard. We may withhold payouts if payout details are incomplete or if we detect suspicious or fraudulent activity.



5) Marketing & Brand Guidelines



Affiliates may promote LUMIEVE using approved channels such as social media, blogs, and content platforms.

Affiliates must:


  • Clearly disclose the affiliate relationship (FTC disclosure) in posts/videos (example: “This post contains affiliate links. I may earn a commission.”)

  • Avoid misleading claims (including medical claims) or deceptive content

  • Use only approved brand assets when provided




6) Prohibited Promotion



The following are not allowed unless we give written permission:


  • Brand bidding / bidding on “LUMIEVE” or close variations in search ads

  • Spam email, unsolicited messages, or automated outreach

  • Coupon scraping sites, cashback, forced clicks, pop-ups/pop-unders, toolbars/extensions

  • Adult, pornographic, hateful, or illegal content



Violation may result in removal from the Program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.



7) Cookies & Attribution



We use cookies to track referrals. If customers block or clear cookies, tracking may not work and commissions may not be credited.



8) Removal / Termination



We may suspend or terminate any affiliate at any time for violation of these terms or for suspected fraud.

Affiliates may request removal by contacting: SUPPORT@LUMIEVEGLOW.COM


Thank you for partnering with LUMIEVE!
